arrival_model: closed-loop with fixed worker count; after 30s stop dispatch at first complete manifest-cycle boundary, then drain
warmup: one complete traversal of each slice before its measurement
request_order: deterministic seeded shuffle per slice; repeated cyclically
caches: No historical request or response caching; native exact request-local reuse and vLLM engine prefix caching explicitly selected in run plan; vLLM endpoint generates a fresh salt per request.
overflow_cases: test separately; never truncate or include expected failures in successful throughput
precision_reference: Original frozen native baseline, max probability/Score abs drift 0.001 and zero decisions flipped
balance_rationale: Declared before first shape performance run: complete cycles keep every case equally represented despite different backend speeds.
graph_policy: native optional graphs enabled; vLLM default compile/graph
capacity_protocol: Both engines reserve 8192 context capacity; unchanged input manifest max4096, no truncation. VJ exact4096 capacity boundary hangs; independent diagnostic020 showed8192 resolves.
